Sir Godfrey Kneller

[A celebrated portrait-painter; born at Lübec, 1648; after studying with Rembrandt and in Italy, became court painter to Charles II. and other English sovereigns; died about 1723.]
Dost thou think, man, I can make thy son a painter? No! only God Almighty makes painters!
Declining to take his tailor’s son as his pupil.
